name: dokidlc
description: DaftDoki's plugins for the agents in ~/Code/agents: questlog, iirc, unslop, writing-for-agents, readme, and naming-is-hard.

plugins.name: questlog
plugins.description: Quests and chores through one flat machine of states, with creator review

plugins.name: iirc
plugins.description: What past sessions learned, as markdown pages in .iirc/, built on Cal Paterson's memoryfields, searched semantically, with suspicion instead of expiry

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Cut AI tells from any writing. pstack lineage with the soul section narrowed to selection, rule 34 for knowing asides, and model invocation kept; puts itself in context at session and subagent start

plugins.name: writing-for-agents
plugins.description: Writing documents for agents: skills, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and any document an agent reads. Matt Pocock's skill, vendored

plugins.name: readme
plugins.description: Write, grade, and keep a README.md for the person deciding whether to use the software. One skill with three verbs and a checker on PATH that gates on why and status

plugins.name: naming-is-hard
plugins.description: Names a person understands on first read: a naming rule Claude follows, and two name reviews
